Benefits of MuscleBlaze Muesli Dark Chocolate & Cranberry 2 kg
Making MuscleBlaze High Protein Muesli Dark Chocolate & Cranberry 2 kg your staple breakfast, you enjoy various benefits:

Increased protein intake: Every serving of this muesli with 250 ml of water gives you close to 19g of protein. This accounts for 30% of your daily protein requirement. For those who are looking for vegetarian sources of protein or want a convenient solution to meet their protein needs, MuscleBlaze Protein Muesli Dark Chocolate & Cranberry 1 kg is a reliable option.
Weight management support: When it comes to weight management, the biggest hurdles that people face are hunger pangs and food cravings. Using this protein and fibre-rich muesli in the morning helps you stay satiated for longer periods of time. They are also available in delicious flavours which is a healthy way to settle those cravings for something sweet every once in a while.
Enhanced immune response: As the free radicals in the body begin to build up, the immune system experiences extreme stress. It also diverts the function of the immune system, making it less efficient when your body is invaded by pathogens. The antioxidants in the specialised formula of MuscleBlaze High Protein Muesli, 1kg, Dark Chocolate & Cranberry help neutralise these free radicals, giving you a stronger immune response.
Better digestive health: Fibre is necessary to maintain digestive health. It allows the smooth movement of food through the digestive tract. This also improves the absorption of nutrients that are consumed throughout the day. MuscleBlaze High Protein Muesli Dark Chocolate & Cranberry 2 kg contains four types of whole grains which improve your fibre intake, improving your gut health.
When to Consume
The best time to consume MuscleBlaze High Protein Muesli Dark Chocolate & Cranberry 2 kg is in the morning. It is the perfect breakfast item as it comes with a healthy balance of proteins, vitamins, minerals and fibre.

Those who train regularly also benefit from using it as a post-workout snack as it is rich in proteins. This speeds up the muscle recovery process, preventing soreness the next day. You can also use a serving of this protein-rich muesli as a healthy alternative to snacks that you include between your meals.

Energy- 411 kCal
Protein- 22g

Total Sugars- 20 g
Added Sugars- 9.98 g
Dietary Fibre- 9 g

Composition of MuscleBlaze Muesli Dark Chocolate & Cranberry 2 kg
The health benefits of MuscleBlaze Protein Muesli Dark Chocolate & Cranberry 2 kg comes from the composition which includes:

Protein: 19g of protein in every bowl of muesli with 250 ml of milk accounts for 30% of the daily required protein intake.
Vitamins and Minerals: A blend of fruits and nuts along with seeds like pumpkin and chia seeds provides a source of important micronutrients.
Fibre: With a 45% composition of whole grains including oats, barley, quinoa and brown rice is a great source of fibre.
Precautions To Take When Consuming
There are some precautions to take when you are consuming this nutrient-rich muesli:

If you have nut allergies, the fruit and nut blend can cause an allergic reaction.
This product also contains soy and ingredients like barley and oats that are allergens.
If you suffer from issues like constipation, then the high fibre content can lead to digestive issues.
Those who are lactose intolerant may use plant-based or lactose-free milk to get the same benefits.
Why to Buy
Everyone understands the importance of breakfast. But, preparing a healthy breakfast given how busy mornings can get is a challenge. MuscleBlaze Protein Muesli Dark Chocolate & Cranberry 2 kg is the perfect addition to a diet that is targeted at specific fitness goals including weight loss and muscle building as it contains the right blend of nutrients. If you need a healthy snack alternative or post-workout food that is healthy and tasty, you should consider buying this product.
